declaration.negotiation_history_statement: I submit this declaration in support of preliminary approval under Rule 23(e). The parties reached the proposed settlement through arm’s-length negotiations. Because those negotiations are confidential mediation communications, I do not recount the parties’ offers or statements. The agreement provides a $29 million class fund, distributed automatically to identified members without a claims process. Brightline will separately pay up to $2 million in attorneys’ fees and expenses, subject to the Court’s approval; it has not agreed to refrain from opposing the request, and any amount not awarded will go to the class rather than revert to Brightline. In my judgment, the settlement warrants preliminary approval: it provides substantial, direct relief now, while continued litigation would entail significant class-certification risk, uncertain trial recovery, and years of delay. Final approval remains subject to notice, any objections, and the Court’s independent review.
